verses.geez: ናሁ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጸባኦት፡ ያአትት፡ እምኢየሩሳሌም፡ ወእምይሁዳ፡ ጽኑዓነ፡ ወጽንዓተ፣፡ ኃይለ፡ እክል፡ ወኃይለ፡ ማይ።
verses.translation: Behold now, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, will take away from Jerusalem and from Judea the mighty man and mighty woman, the strength of bread, and the strength of water,

translations.lxx: Behold now, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, will take away from Jerusalem and from Judea the mighty man and mighty woman, the strength of bread, and the strength of water,
translations.kjv: For, behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water.
translations.ron: Iată, Domnul Dumnezeu Savaot va lua din Ierusalim şi din Iuda orice sprijin şi orice ajutor, orice hrană de pâine şi orice sprijin de apă,
translations.grk: Ἰδοὺ δὴ ὁ δεσπότης Κύριος σαβαὼθ ἀφελεῖ ἀπὸ Ἱερουσαλὴμ, καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰουδαίας, ἰσχύοντα καὶ ἰσχύουσαν, ἰσχὺν ἄρτου καὶ ἰσχὺν ὕδατος,

verses.geez: ወኃይለ፡ ያርብሕ፡ ወኃይለ፡ ብእሲ፡ መስተቃትል፡ ወመኰንነ፡ ወነቢየ፡ ወማእምረ፡ ወልሂቀ።
verses.translation: the great and mighty man, the warrior and the judge, and the prophet, and the counsellor, and the elder,

translations.lxx: the great and mighty man, the warrior and the judge, and the prophet, and the counsellor, and the elder,
translations.kjv: The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,
translations.ron: Pe viteaz şi pe omul de luptă, pe judecător şi pe prooroc, pe prezicător şi pe bătrân;
translations.grk: γίγαντα καὶ ἰσχύοντα, καὶ ἄνθρωπον πολεμιστὴν, καὶ δικαστὴν, καὶ προφήτην, καὶ στοχαστὴν, καὶ πρεσβύτερον,

verses.geez: ወመስፍነ፡ ወመካሬ፡ ወጠቢበ፡ ሊቀ፡ ጸረብት፡ ወለባዌ፡ ወመጽምዔ፡ ነገር።
verses.translation: the captain of fifty also, and the honourable counsellor, and the wise artificer, and the intelligent hearer.

translations.lxx: the captain of fifty also, and the honourable counsellor, and the wise artificer, and the intelligent hearer.
translations.kjv: The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counsellor, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.
translations.ron: Pe căpetenia peste cincizeci, pe sfătuitor, pe înţelept, pe fermecător şi pe ghicitor.
translations.grk: καὶ πεντηκόνταρχον, καὶ θαυμαστὸν σύμβουλον, καὶ σοφὸν ἀρχιτέκτονα, καὶ συνετὸν ἀκροατήν.

verses.geez: ወእሠይም፡ ወራዙተ፡ መላእክቲሆሙ፡ ወመስተሳልቃን፡ ይኴንንዎሙ።
verses.translation: And I will make youths their princes, and mockers shall have dominion over them.

translations.lxx: And I will make youths their princes, and mockers shall have dominion over them.
translations.kjv: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.
translations.ron: Voi pune băieţi căpetenii peste ei şi copiii vor domni peste aceia.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπιστήσω νεανίσκους ἄρχοντας αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐμπαίκται κυριεύσουσιν αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወይወድቅ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ዲበ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ወብእሲ፡ ዲበ፡ ብእሲ፡ ወሰብእ፡ ዲበ፡ ቢጹ፤ ወይትዐቀፍ፡ ደቂቅ፡ በልሂቅ፡ ወኅሡር፡ በክቡር።
verses.translation: And the people shall fall, man upon man, and every man upon his neighbour: the child shall insult the elder man, and the base the honourable.

translations.lxx: And the people shall fall, man upon man, and every man upon his neighbour: the child shall insult the elder man, and the base the honourable.
translations.kjv: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.
translations.ron: În popor se vor strâmtora unul pe altul şi fiecare va împila pe aproapele său; cel tânăr se va purta obraznic cu cel bătrân şi cel de neam rău cu cel de neam bun.
translations.grk: Καὶ συμπεσεῖται ὁ λαὸς, ἄνθρωπος πρὸς ἄνθρωπον, καὶ ἄνθρωπος πρὸς τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ· προσκόψει τὸ παιδίον πρὸς τὸν πρεσβύτην, ὁ ἄτιμος πρὸς τὸν ἔντιμον.

verses.geez: ወይእኅዝ፡ ሰብእ፡ ቢጾ፡ ወሰብአ፡ ቤተ፡ አቡሁ፡ ወይብሎ፤ ለእመ፡ ብከ፡ ልብሰ፡ ኩነኒ፡ መልአከ፡ ወሴስየኒ።
verses.translation: For a man shall lay hold of his brother, as one of his father's household, saying, Thou hast raiment, be thou our ruler, and let my meat be under thee.

translations.lxx: For a man shall lay hold of his brother, as one of his father's household, saying, Thou hast raiment, be thou our ruler, and let my meat be under thee.
translations.kjv: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father, saying, Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and let this ruin be under thy hand:
translations.ron: Atunci va alerga omul la fratele său, în casa tatălui său, şi-i va zice: Tu mai ai o haină, fii căpetenie peste noi şi să fie aceste dărâmături sub mâna ta.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐπιλήψεται ἄνθρωπος τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ, ἢ τοῦ οἰκείου τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ, λέγων, ἱμάτιον ἔχεις, ἀρχηγὸς γενοῦ ἡμῶν, καὶ τὸ βρῶμα τὸ ἐμὸν ὑπὸ σὲ ἔστω.

verses.geez: ወይሠጠዎ፡ ውእተ፡ አሚረ፡ ወይብሎ፤ ኢይከውነከ፡ መልአከ፡ እስመ፡ አልብየ፡ እክለ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤትየ፡ ወኢልብሰ፣፡ ወኢይከውን፡ መልአከ፡ ለዝሕዝብ።
verses.translation: And he shall answer in that day, and say, I will not be thy ruler; for I have no bread in my house, nor raiment: I will not be the ruler of this people.

translations.lxx: And he shall answer in that day, and say, I will not be thy ruler; for I have no bread in my house, nor raiment: I will not be the ruler of this people.
translations.kjv: In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.
translations.ron: Iar acela cu jurământ se va lepăda, zicând: "Nu pot vindeca rănile poporului! N-am în casa mea nici pâine, nici haină, nu mă faceţi conducător peste popor!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐρεῖ, οὐκ ἔσομαί σου ἀρχηγός· οὐ γάρ ἐστιν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ μου ἄρτος, οὐδὲ ἱμάτιον· οὐκ ἔσομαι ἀρχηγὸς τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኀለፈት፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ ወይሁዳኒ፡ ወድቀት፡ ወልሳኖሙኒ፡ ዓማፂ፡ ዘይክሕድዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judea has fallen, and their tongues have spoken with iniquity, disobedient as they are towards the Lord.

translations.lxx: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judea has fallen, and their tongues have spoken with iniquity, disobedient as they are towards the Lord.
translations.kjv: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.
translations.ron: Ierusalimul va ajunge dărâmătură şi Iuda este gata să cadă, căci limba lor şi gândurile lor sunt împotriva Domnului şi dispreţuiesc privirea slavei Lui.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἀνεῖται Ἱερουσαλὴμ, καὶ ἡ Ἰουδαία συμπέπτωκε, καὶ αἱ γλῶσσαι αὐτῶν μετὰ ἀνομίας, τὰ πρὸς Κύριον ἀπειθοῦντες. Διότι νῦν ἐταπεινώθη ἡ δόξα αὐτῶν,

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ይእዜ፡ ኀሥረት፡ ክብሮሙ፡ ወተኀፍረት፡ ገጾሙ፤ ወተቃወመቶሙ፡ ኃጢአቶሙ፡ ከመ፡ ኃጢአተ፡ ሰዶም፡ አስተርአየት፡ ወተዐውቀት፡ ላዕሌሆሙ።
verses.translation: Wherefore now their glory has been brought low, and the shame of their countenance has withstood them, and they have proclaimed their sin as Sodom, and made it manifest.

translations.lxx: Wherefore now their glory has been brought low, and the shame of their countenance has withstood them, and they have proclaimed their sin as Sodom, and made it manifest.
translations.kjv: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.
translations.ron: Înfăţişarea lor mărturiseşte împotriva lor, căci ei îşi vădesc păcatele lor ca Sodoma, în loc să fie ascundă. Vai de ei! Căci ei şi-au făcut loruşi rău...
translations.grk: καὶ ἡ αἰσχύνη τοῦ προσώπου αὐτῶν ἀντέστη αὐτοῖς· τὴν δὲ ἁμαρτίαν αὐτῶν ὡς Σοδόμων ἀνήγγειλαν καὶ ἐνεφάνισαν· οὐαὶ τῇ ψυχῇ αὐτῶν, διότι βεβούλευνται βουλὴν πονηρὰν, καθʼ ἑαυτῶν

verses.geez: ወይቤሉ፤ ንእስሮ፡ ለጻድቅ፡ እስመ፡ ዕጹብ፡ ወክቡድ፡ ውእቱ፡ ለነ።
verses.translation: Woe to their soul, for they have devised an evil counsel against themselves, saying against themselves, Let us bind the just, for he is burdensome to us: therefore shall they eat the fruits of their works.

translations.lxx: Woe to their soul, for they have devised an evil counsel against themselves, saying against themselves, Let us bind the just, for he is burdensome to us: therefore shall they eat the fruits of their works.
translations.kjv: Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well with him: for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
translations.ron: Fericit este omul drept, că el va mânca din rodul lucrurilor lui.
translations.grk: εἰπόντες, δήσωμεν τὸν δίκαιον, ὅτι δύσχρηστος ἡμῖν ἐστι· τοίνυν τὰ γεννήματα τῶν ἔργων αὐτῶν φάγονται.

verses.geez: አሌሎ፡ ለኃጥእ፡ በእከዩ፣፡ በከመ፡ እከየ፡ ምግባረ፡ እደዊሆሙ፡ ይረክቡ።
verses.translation: Woe to the transgressor! evils shall happen to him according to the works of his hands.

translations.lxx: Woe to the transgressor! evils shall happen to him according to the works of his hands.
translations.kjv: Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him: for the reward of his hands shall be given him.
translations.ron: Vai de cel rău, că răutatea este a lui şi va fi judecat după faptele lui.
translations.grk: Οὐαὶ τῷ ἀνόμῳ, πονηρὰ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν αὐτοῦ συμβήσεται αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: ሕዝብየ፣፡ መኳንቲክሙ፡ ያጽሕቡክሙ፡ ወይሤለጣ፡ ላዕሌክሙ፡ አንስት፤ ሕዝብየ፣፡ እለ፡ ያስተበፅዑክሙ፡ ያስሐቱክሙ፡ ወይደመስሱ፡ አሠረ፡ እገሪክሙ።
verses.translation: O my people, your exactors strip you, and extortioners rule over you: O my people, they that pronounce you blessed lead you astray, and pervert the path of your feet.

translations.lxx: O my people, your exactors strip you, and extortioners rule over you: O my people, they that pronounce you blessed lead you astray, and pervert the path of your feet.
translations.kjv: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.
translations.ron: Poporul meu este asuprit de nişte copii, şi femeile domnesc peste el. Poporul meu! Cei care te conduc te rătăcesc şi te abat de la calea pe care tu mergi.
translations.grk: Λαός μου, οἱ πράκτορες ὑμῶν καλαμῶνται ὑμᾶς, καὶ οἱ ἀπαιτοῦντες κυριεύουσιν ὑμῶν· λαός μου, οἱ μακαρίζοντες ὑμᾶς πλανῶσιν ὑμᾶς, καὶ τὸν τρίβον τῶν ποδῶν ὑμῶν ταράσσουσιν.

verses.geez: ወባሕቱ፡ ይእዜ፡ ይትነሣእ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለኰንኖ፡ ወያቀውሞሙ፡ ለሕዝቡ፡ ከመ፡ ይትዋቀሦሙ።
verses.translation: But now the Lord will stand up for judgment, and will enter into judgment with his people.

translations.lxx: But now the Lord will stand up for judgment, and will enter into judgment with his people.
translations.kjv: The LORD standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.
translations.ron: Domnul Se ridică la judecată şi stă ca să judece pe poporul Său.
translations.grk: Ἀλλὰ νῦν καταστήσεται εἰς κρίσιν Κύριος, καὶ στήσει εἰς κρίσιν τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወይመጽእ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለሊሁ፡ ምስለ፡ ሊቃውንት፡ ሕዝቡ፡ ወምስለ፡ መላእክቲሁ፡ ወይብል፤ አንትሙ፡ አውዐይክሙ፡ ወይንየ፡ ወበርበረ፡ ነዳይ፡ ውስተ፡ አብያቲክሙ።
verses.translation: The Lord himself shall enter into judgment with the elders of the people, and with their rulers: but why have ye set my vineyard on fire, and why is the spoil of the poor in your houses?

translations.lxx: The Lord himself shall enter into judgment with the elders of the people, and with their rulers: but why have ye set my vineyard on fire, and why is the spoil of the poor in your houses?
translations.kjv: The LORD will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.
translations.ron: Domnul intră la judecată cu bătrânii şi cârmuitorii poporului Său şi zice: "Voi, voi aţi pustiit via Mea şi prada luată de la cei sărmani se află în casele voastre.
translations.grk: Αὐτὸς Κύριος εἰς κρίσιν ἥξει μετὰ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων τοῦ λαοῦ, καὶ μετὰ τῶν ἀρχόντων αὐτοῦ· ὑμεῖς δὲ τί ἐνεπυρίσατε τὸν ἀμπελῶνά μου, καὶ ἡ ἁρπαγὴ τοῦ πτωχοῦ ἐν τοῖς οἴκοις ὑμῶν;

verses.geez: ለምንት፡ ትገፍዕዎሙ፡ ለሕዝብየ፡ ወታስተኀፍሩ፡ ገጸ፡ ነዳይ።
verses.translation: Why do ye wrong my people, and shame the face of the poor?

translations.lxx: Why do ye wrong my people, and shame the face of the poor?
translations.kjv: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
translations.ron: Pentru ce aţi zdrobit pe poporul Meu şi aţi sfărâmat faţa celor sărmani?" zice Domnul Dumnezeu Savaot.
translations.grk: Τί ὑμεῖς ἀδικεῖτε τὸν λαόν μου, καὶ τὸ πρόσωπον τῶν πτωχῶν καταισχύνετε;

verses.geez: ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፤ እስመ፡ ተዝኅራ፡ አዋልደ፡ ጽዮን፡ ወየሐውራ፡ እንዘ፡ ያገዝፋ፡ ክሳዶን፡ ወይትቃጸባ፡ በአዕይንቲሆን፡ ወያጽሕሳ፡ በእገሪሆን፡ ወይስሕባ፡ አዝፋረ፡ አልባሲሆን፡ ወየሐውራ፡ እንዘ፡ ይዘፍና።
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord, Because the daughters of Sion are haughty, and have walked with an outstretched neck, and with winking of the eyes, and motion of the feet, at the same time drawing their garments in trains, and at the same time sporting with their feet:

translations.lxx: Thus saith the Lord, Because the daughters of Sion are haughty, and have walked with an outstretched neck, and with winking of the eyes, and motion of the feet, at the same time drawing their garments in trains, and at the same time sporting with their feet:
translations.kjv: Moreover the LORD saith, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:
translations.ron: Şi mai zice Domnul: "Pentru că fiicele Sionului sunt atât de mândre şi umblă cu capul pe sus şi cu priviri obraznice, cu paşi domoli, cu zăngănit de inele la picioarele lor,
translations.grk: Τάδε λέγει Κύριος, ἀνθʼ ὧν ὑψώθησαν αἱ θυγατέρες Σιών, καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ὑψηλῷ τραχήλῳ καὶ ἐν νεύμασιν ὀφθαλμῶν, καὶ τῇ πορείᾳ τῶν ποδῶν ἅμα σύρουσαι τοὺς χιτῶνας, καὶ τοῖς ποσὶν ἅμα παίζουσαι·

verses.geez: ወያኀሥሮን፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለልሂቃተ፡ አዋልደ፡ ጽዮን፡ ወይቀፍጾን፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አልባሲሆን።
verses.translation: therefore the Lord will humble the chief daughters of Sion, and the Lord will expose their form in that day;

translations.lxx: therefore the Lord will humble the chief daughters of Sion, and the Lord will expose their form in that day;
translations.kjv: Therefore the LORD will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will discover their secret parts.
translations.ron: Domnul va pleşuvi creştetul capului fiicelor Sionului, Domnul va descoperi goliciunea lor".
translations.grk: Καὶ ταπεινώσει ὁ Θεὸς ἀρχούσας θυγατέρας Σιών· καὶ Κύριος ἀνακαλύψει τὸ σχῆμα αὐτῶν

verses.geez: ይእተ፡ አሚረ፡ ይሰልቦን፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አልባሰ፡ ክብሮን፡ ወሠርጓቲሆን፡ ወሐብለታቲሆን፡ ወባዝግናቲሆን።
verses.translation: and the Lord will take away the glory of their raiment, the curls and the fringes, and the crescents,

translations.lxx: and the Lord will take away the glory of their raiment, the curls and the fringes, and the crescents,
translations.kjv: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,
translations.ron: În ziua aceea va lua Domnul toate podoabele: inele, sori, luniţe,
translations.grk: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ, καὶ ἀφελεῖ Κύριος τὴν δόξαν τοῦ ἱματισμοῦ αὐτῶν, τὰ ἐμπλόκια, καὶ τοὺς κοσύμβους, καὶ τοὺς μηνίσκους,

verses.geez: ወቀጸላቲሆን፡ ወባሕርያቲሆን፡ ወአውቃፊሆን።
verses.translation: and the chains, and the ornaments of their faces,

translations.lxx: and the chains, and the ornaments of their faces,
translations.kjv: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,
translations.ron: Cercei, brăţări, văluri,
translations.grk: καὶ τὸ κάθεμα, καὶ τὸν κόσμον τοῦ προσώπου αὐτῶν,

verses.geez: ወአዕኑጊሆን፡ ወሕልቀታቲሆን፡ ወክብሶን፡ ወአልባሲሆን፡ ዘሜላት።
verses.translation: and the array of glorious ornaments, and the armlets, and the bracelets, and the wreathed work, and the finger-rings, and the ornaments for the right hand, and the ear-rings,

translations.lxx: and the array of glorious ornaments, and the armlets, and the bracelets, and the wreathed work, and the finger-rings, and the ornaments for the right hand, and the ear-rings,
translations.kjv: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,
translations.ron: Cununi, lănţişoare, cingătoare, miresme, talismane,
translations.grk: καὶ τὴν σύνθεσιν τοῦ κόσμου τῆς δόξης, καὶ τοὺς χλιδῶνας, καὶ τὰ ψέλλια, καὶ τὸ ἐμπλόκιον, καὶ τοὺς δακτυλίους, καὶ τὰ περιδέξια, καὶ τὰ ἐνώτια,

verses.geez: ወዘሢራይ፡ ወዘስግላጥ።
verses.translation: and the garments with scarlet borders, and the garments with purple grounds,

translations.lxx: and the garments with scarlet borders, and the garments with purple grounds,
translations.kjv: The rings, and nose jewels,
translations.ron: Inele, verigi de nas,
translations.grk: καὶ τὰ περιπόρφυρα, καὶ τὰ μεσοπόρφυρα,

verses.geez: ወአልባሰ፡ ወርቅ፡ ወአልባሰ፡ ዐስቅ።
verses.translation: and the shawls to be worn in the house, and the Spartan transparent dresses,

translations.lxx: and the shawls to be worn in the house, and the Spartan transparent dresses,
translations.kjv: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,
translations.ron: Veşminte de sărbătoare, mantii, şaluri, pungi,
translations.grk: καὶ τὰ ἐπιβλήματα τὰ κατὰ τὴν οἰκίαν, καὶ τὰ διαφανῆ Λακωνικά,

verses.geez: ወዐራዞን፡ ኵሎ፡ ወመዋጥሒሆን፡ ዘሰንሰሪቍ።
verses.translation: and those made of fine linen, and the purple ones, and the scarlet ones, and the fine linen, interwoven with gold and purple, and the light coverings for couches.

translations.lxx: and those made of fine linen, and the purple ones, and the scarlet ones, and the fine linen, interwoven with gold and purple, and the light coverings for couches.
translations.kjv: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.
translations.ron: Oglinzi, pânzeturi subţiri, turbane şi tunici.
translations.grk: καὶ τὰ βύσσινα, καὶ τὰ ὑακίνθινα, καὶ κόκκινα, καὶ τὴν βύσσον, σὺν χρυσῷ καὶ ὑακίνθῳ συγκαθυφασμένα, καὶ θέριστρα κατάκλιτα.

verses.geez: ወህየንተ፡ መዐዛ፡ ዕፍረትኪ፡ ጸበል፡ ይኩንኪ፡ ወህየንተ፡ ቅናትኪ፡ ዘወርቅ፡ ሐብለ፡ ቅንቲ፤ ወህየንተ፡ ቀጸላኪ፡ ዘወርቅ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ርእስኪ፡ ብርሐት፡ ትፃእኪ፡ በእንተ፡ እከየ፡ ምግባርኪ፤ ወህየንተ፡ መልበስኪ፡ ዘሜላት፡ ልበሲ፡ ሠቀ።
verses.translation: And there shall be instead of a sweet smell, dust; and instead of a girdle, thou shalt gird thyself with a rope; and instead of a golden ornament for the head, thou shalt have baldness on account of thy works; and instead of a tunic with a scarlet ground, thou shalt gird thyself with sackcloth.

translations.lxx: And there shall be instead of a sweet smell, dust; and instead of a girdle, thou shalt gird thyself with a rope; and instead of a golden ornament for the head, thou shalt have baldness on account of thy works; and instead of a tunic with a scarlet ground, thou shalt gird thyself with sackcloth.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; and burning instead of beauty.
translations.ron: Atunci va fi în loc de miresme, putreziciune, şi în loc de cingători, frânghie, în loc de cârlionţi făcuţi cu fierul, pleşuvie, în loc de veşmânt preţios, zdrenţe, şi în loc de frumuseţe: pecete de robie.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται ἀντὶ ὀσμῆς ἡδείας, κονιορτός· καὶ ἀντὶ ζώνης, σχοινίῳ ζώσῃ· καὶ ἀντὶ τοῦ κόσμου τῆς κεφαλῆς τοῦ χρυσίου, φαλάκρωμα ἕξεις διὰ τὰ ἔργα σοῦ· καὶ ἀντὶ τοῦ χιτῶνος τοῦ μεσοπορφύρου, περιζώσῃ σάκκον.

verses.geez: ወወልድኪ፡ ዘይልህቅ፡ ዘታፈቅርዮ፡ ይወድቅ፡ በኵናት፡ ወኃያላንኪ፡ በጸብእ።
verses.translation: And thy most beautiful son whom thou lovest shall fall by the sword; and your mighty men shall fall by the sword, and shall be brought low.

translations.lxx: And thy most beautiful son whom thou lovest shall fall by the sword; and your mighty men shall fall by the sword, and shall be brought low.
translations.kjv: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.
translations.ron: Locuitorii Sionului vor cădea de sabie şi vitejii lui în războaie.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὁ υἱός σου ὁ κάλλιστος ὃν ἀγαπᾷς, μαχαίρᾳ πεσεῖται· καὶ οἱ ἰσχύοντες ὑμῶν, μαχαίρᾳ πεσοῦνται, καὶ ταπεινωθήσονται·

verses.geez: ይትኀፈሩ፡ ወይላሕዉ፡ አስከሬናተ፡ ሠርጕኪ፤ ወትተርፊ፡ ባሕቲትኪ፡ ወይነፅኁኪ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: And the stores of your ornaments shall mourn, and thou shalt be left alone, and shalt be levelled with the ground.

translations.lxx: And the stores of your ornaments shall mourn, and thou shalt be left alone, and shalt be levelled with the ground.
translations.kjv: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.
translations.ron: Porţile fiicei Sionului vor scârţâi şi se vor jeli şi, jefuită, ea va şedea despuiată pe pământ.
translations.grk: Καὶ πενθήσουσιν αἱ θῆκαι τοῦ κόσμου ὑμῶν· καὶ καταλειφθήσῃ μόνη, καὶ εἰς τὴν γῆν ἐδαφισθήσῃ.
